name: Gangut
shortDescription: Twelve 305mm guns spread across four triple turrets set at a single deck level instead of superfiring pairs, the widest broadside of her tier III peers but the slowest reload and thinnest hull.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.flavor: 3 charges, 10s action, 40s cooldown. The On Demand Repairs trait trades the usual unlimited-charge cycle for a much faster reset, half Nevada's 80s cooldown, but she runs out after three uses.

consumables.name: Repair Party
consumables.flavor: 2 charges, 28s at 202 hp/s, about 5,660 hp per activation, roughly 15% of her 37,600 hp pool.

consumables.name: Enhanced Secondary Targeting
consumables.flavor: 3 charges, 30s window, +100% secondary shell grouping and -50% dispersion, 160s cooldown. A real boost to a 16-gun secondary battery that already hits hard at brawling range.

turrets.note: Amidships mount, needs close to a full broadside to bear, can't hit bow or stern targets.
Amidships mount, needs close to a full broadside to bear, can't hit bow or stern targets.

strengths: Twelve guns across just four turrets, the fewest mounts of any tier III battleship carrying that many guns, so there's less to knock out one hit at a time
12.0 km sea detection beats Kaiser's 12.5, Wyoming's 12.5, Orion's 12.6, and Ishizuchi's 12.9, the best concealment of her tech-tree tier III peers
14.3s rudder shift is the quickest of that same peer group
16-gun secondary battery hits hard once someone closes the range
On Demand Repairs resets Damage Control Party in 40s instead of the usual 80-90s, so fire and flood spam gets punished less
weaknesses: 36s main battery reload is well behind Nassau's 22.2s, Ishizuchi's 25s, Kaiser's 26s, and Wyoming/Orion's 30s, the slowest of the group by a wide margin
37,600 hp is the lowest hull pool among tech-tree tier III battleships
9% torpedo damage reduction is the second-softest of her peers, only Ishizuchi's 4% is worse
Turrets 2 and 3 are locked to broadside only and can't answer a target off the bow or stern
12.1 km main battery range is the shortest of her tier III peer group
tips: Two of your four turrets can't fire unless you're actually showing broadside, so don't expect a full 12-gun salvo at an awkward angle.
Commit to your angle early. A 36s reload punishes a wasted salvo hard.
On Demand Repairs only gives you three charges, don't burn one on a single small fire, but don't be afraid to use it either since it's back in 40s.
Let fights come to mid-range if you can. Her secondary battery adds real damage once someone closes in.

threats.reason: 9% torpedo damage reduction is the second-softest of her tier III peers, so a spread hurts more than her armor rating suggests.

threats.threat: Ships that can sit off her bow or stern
threats.reason: Turrets 2 and 3 are locked to broadside only, so she loses half her main battery the moment she can't show her side.

summary: Twelve 305mm guns across four turrets at one deck level instead of superfiring pairs, built to get every gun into the broadside at once.
Best concealment and quickest rudder of her tech-tree tier III peers, but the slowest reload and lowest hp pool of the group.
On Demand Repairs trades Damage Control Party's usual long cooldown for a fast 40s reset, at the cost of only three charges total.
playstyle.detail: Gangut spreads her twelve guns across four turrets set at a single deck level rather than stacking them in superfiring pairs, a layout aimed at one thing: getting every gun into the broadside at once. Turrets 1 and 4 can still swing to cover the bow or stern, but turrets 2 and 3 sit locked onto the beam, so she really is built to fight from the side. The cost of that gun count shows up in a 36 second reload, the slowest of her tier, and a hull that's thinner than any other tech-tree battleship at tier III. On Demand Repairs offsets some of the risk, a Damage Control Party that resets in 40 seconds instead of the usual minute-plus, though it runs out after three uses. Get the angle set early and she pays it back with a wide, hard-hitting broadside.
